transformation: Bundle each source table's Hf(298.15 K), H(T)-H(298.15 K), and S(T) columns. Runtime apparent G(T) = Hf(298.15 K) + [H(T)-H(298.15 K)] - T*S(T), converting kJ/mol enthalpies and J/(mol K) entropy to J/mol. Interpolate source enthalpy increment and entropy separately, linearly. Also retain finite enthalpy-increment/entropy columns from identified transition lines in parse_ambiguities; use the crystal-liquid row at its inclusive cap when one is printed.
source_span_rule: Finite source enthalpy-increment and entropy nodes; evaluation starts at 298.15 K.
phase_restriction_rule: A JANAF crystal is valid through its declared source cap, inclusive. A crystal-to-liquid transition sets the cap when printed; otherwise the last tabulated crystal node sets it. Never evaluate above the cap.
